info.name: E-Commerce - Order Service
info.description: Run top to bottom with the Collection Runner (right-click → Run collection): the 'Wait for ...' requests retry until a Kafka event has arrived, which only works in the Runner. Goes through the api-gateway on 8080, so start PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis and all seven services first (user, product, inventory, cart, order, payment, gateway). Every run uses a new customer and a unique tag.

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('inventory-service created Phone', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
